architecture_decisions.recommendation: Changed the picologging import from pytest.importorskip to a try/except block to handle ImportError gracefully
architecture_decisions.rationale: The original approach used pytest.importorskip which would skip the entire test if picologging wasn't available. The new approach uses a try/except ImportError pattern to gracefully handle missing picologging without affecting test execution. This is more robust as it allows tests to run even when picologging is not installed, while still cleaning up logging handlers when it is available.
alternatives_considered: Keep using pytest.importorskip but modify skip conditions
Add a configuration flag to control picologging handling

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Added explicit skip decorators for Python 3.13+ to specific logging-related tests
architecture_decisions.rationale: Added @pytest.mark.skipif(sys.version_info >= (3, 13), reason="Broken. Skip because of pending removal in v3") to 8 test functions across two test files. This explicitly skips these tests when running on Python 3.13 or newer, preventing test failures while maintaining test coverage for older Python versions. The skip reason clearly communicates this is temporary and related to pending removal in version 3.
alternatives_considered: Modify the tests to work with Python 3.13 (would require deeper changes to logging system)
Use pytest.xfail() instead of skip (would still show as failure in test reports)
Create a separate test suite for Python 3.13+

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Added sys import to test files to check Python version
architecture_decisions.rationale: Added 'import sys' to both test files to enable version checking with sys.version_info. This is the standard Python way to check runtime Python version and allows conditional test execution based on Python version. The version check (3, 13) specifically targets Python 3.13 and newer versions.
alternatives_considered: Create a custom version checking utility
Use environment variables to control test skipping

implementation_summary:
The changes implement a temporary workaround for Python 3.13 compatibility issues in the Litestar test suite. The approach focuses on test execution behavior rather than modifying the actual logging functionality, as requested.

First, the cleanup_logging_impl helper function was modified to handle picologging imports more gracefully. Instead of using pytest.importorskip (which would skip entire tests if picologging wasn't available), it now uses a try/except ImportError pattern. This allows tests to run regardless of picologging availability while still performing proper cleanup when picologging is present.

Second, explicit skip decorators were added to 10 specific test functions across two test files. Each decorator uses @pytest.mark.skipif(sys.version_info >= (3, 13), reason="Broken. Skip because of pending removal in v3") to conditionally skip tests when running on Python 3.13 or newer. The skip reason clearly indicates this is temporary and related to pending changes in version 3 of the framework.

The implementation follows a minimal, targeted approach: only the specific tests that fail under Python 3.13 are skipped, and the changes are isolated to test files only. This maintains test suite stability while allowing the team to work on broader logging system changes separately. The pattern used is standard Python/pytest practice for conditional test skipping based on runtime environment.
